description_text: Lead end-to-end market performance analytics for Canada, delivering clear, actionable insights across all TCE lines of business. Translate data into strategic recommendations to drive growth, optimize performance, and enhance customer experience. Identify emerging trends, risks, and opportunities to inform forward-looking business strategies and investment decisions. Support and actively contribute to key strategic initiatives, including Project Himalaya, North Star, and Project Taurus. Manage and optimize the Centurion portfolio through data-driven insights, performance tracking, and targeted opportunity identification. Develop and evolve performance metrics and KPIs aligned to business objectives (e.g., conversion, engagement, share of wallet, experience quality). Build and deliver comprehensive reporting and dashboards to monitor performance, track progress, and highlight areas for improvement. Partner closely with operations, analytics, and global teams to ensure data integrity, consistency, and alignment of performance methodologies. Provide strategic support for long-range planning, including scenario analysis, forecasting, and business case development. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to embed insights into execution and ensure measurable business impact. Ensure all performance strategies and initiatives align with applicable regulatory requirements, including TICO (Ontario) and OPC (Quebec). Support for financial-well-being and retirement Proven experience in analytics, business performance management, or strategy within financial services, travel, or servicing environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize complex data into clear insights and recommendations. Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive outcomes in a cross-functional, matrixed organization. Strong understanding of performance metrics, business drivers, and customer experience levers. Experience supporting strategic initiatives and translating insights into execution. Knowledge of regulatory frameworks relevant to the Canadian market, including TICO and OPC. Proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Cornerstone, Excel, SQL, LUMI, Tableau) and familiarity with AI-driven analytics. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to senior leadership. Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Analytics, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus. Experience in Travel & Concierge Experiences or premium servicing environments. Familiarity with Centurion or high-value customer portfolio management. Experience working on large-scale transformation or strategic initiatives. Exposure to global or multi-market environments.

Working under the guidance of the B35 Manager, the Analyst contributes to continuous improvement and process optimisation, helping evolve the Reporting Processes Hub into a scalable, efficient, and risk-managed delivery model. Execute end-to-end regulatory reporting processes, ensuring outputs are accurate, complete, and delivered on time, in line with defined standard operating procedures (SOPs) maintain consistency in execution across markets. Perform data analysis, validation, and reconciliation to ensure data integrity, identify issues, and support reliable reporting outcomes. Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting outputs (e.g. Excel, Power BI), translating data into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders. Leverage data, automation, and AI/GenAI tools to optimise reporting processes, improve efficiency, and enhance accuracy and turnaround times. Identify opportunities to standardise, streamline, and improve reporting workflows, supporting scalable delivery across multiple markets. Partner with stakeholders across Governance, Compliance, Data, and Operations to support effective reporting delivery and resolve data-related issues. Ensure all reporting and AI-enabled processes comply with control, data governance, and regulatory requirements, maintaining audit-ready outputs. Support for financial-well-being and retirement 3-5 years of experience in reporting, data analysis, or regulatory/control environments. + business acumen, interpret data Strong technical foundation with hands-on experience in data analysis, reporting, and automation tools. Advanced Excel, SQL, and data visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI) are required; experience with Python or similar is a plus. Strong analytical skills with the ability to manipulate, validate, and interpret data, and translate it into clear leadership-ready insights. Excellent English communication skills (verbal and written), with the ability to present insights clearly and effectively. Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and reporting timelines in a structured environment. High attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy, quality, and audit-ready outputs. Experience in building dashboards, reports and automated data solutions to improve efficiency and consistency. Familiarity with AI/NLP or automation tools to support data analysis, insight generation, and reporting efficiency. Ability to perform data validation, reconciliation, and consistency checks across reporting outputs.

Execute governance and oversight activities across regulatory and reporting processes, ensuring alignment with defined standards, internal policies, control frameworks and regulatory requirements. Support end-to-end process oversight by monitoring execution, identifying control gaps, and ensuring activities are completed accurately and on time. Perform control validations, documentation reviews, and evidence checks to ensure completeness, consistency, accuracy and timely reporting, while maintaining high-quality governance records for audit readiness. Support control and testing activities (e.g. PRSA, PPCR or similar), including evidence review, issue tracking, and remediation follow-up. Identify risks, control weaknesses, and process gaps, and escalate issues proactively with clear context and recommended actions. Track actions, dependencies, risks, and issues, ensuring clear ownership, timely resolution, and proper documentation of outcomes. Support preparation of materials for governance forums, and leadership updates. Partner with stakeholders across Governance, Compliance, and Operations to ensure clarity of roles, effective collaboration, and adherence to reporting expectations. Document current and future-state processes, identifying opportunities for standardisation, optimisation, and continuous improvement to support scalable delivery and operating model evolution. Support for financial-well-being and retirement 3-5 years of experience in governance, risk, control, or regulatory environments. Strong understanding of control and testing frameworks (e.g. PRSA, PPCR, RCSA or similar). High attention to detail with a strong focus on control quality, documentation, and audit readiness. Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify risks, control gaps, and execution issues. Ability to interpret operational data and support clear, accurate, and insight-driven governance reporting. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a structured environment. Excellent English communication skills (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate risks and issues. Sound judgement and confidence to challenge constructively and escalate risks early where required. Strong stakeholders' management skills, with the ability to build relationships, drive cross-functional collaboration, and coordinate across multiple stakeholders while maintaining clear accountability.
